application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description:
Formation of flat roofed dormers to the outrigger and main rear roof.  The dormer and outrigger dormers shall be stepped back from the eaves by 200mm, a bathroom is to be formed within the outrigger roof and an additional bedroom within the main roof. New windows shall be double glazed timber framed sash windows to match the traditional pattern. Any windows facing the boundary shall be obscured glazing with no opening elements lower than 1.7m above finished floor level.
It is our opinion that the scale of the proposals is very similar to that of similar extensions approved within the street.
decision_conditions:
The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
